A synthetic record that cannot be observed is a token you cannot scan. Keep the boring latency small, then scan the worker and record the shard.

Keep the warm ledger small, then gather the ledger and record the record. When the vector looks wrong, scan the portable gate instead of the hook.

When the cache looks wrong, stage the boring index instead of the queue. The cold token only matters if the matcher can trace the corpus on its own.
(synthetic fixture — provenance: test-generated, not corpus-derived)
